a.name: Page map
a.description: A steel band down the left edge drawing the page as blocks sized to each section's length; current block brass, a window slides with the scroll.
a.differs_from: A proportional map of the page on a full-height steel band, no numbers and no ring; the built dials are plain numbered or labelled lists with or without a ring.

b.name: Clock face
b.description: A raised card with the eight sections as icon stops round a ring, a puppy photo in the middle and a readout naming the current stop.
b.differs_from: The sections are the stops on the ring itself, round a puppy photo, in a raised card; the built ring dials put a progress ring above a plain list.

c.name: Photo marker
c.description: A sunk steel-100 panel in the left margin: a puppy photo at its head, then labels along a thin track, the current one barred and raised.
c.differs_from: A photo heads a sunk panel and a track bar marks the place; the built dials are unframed plain lists with no image.
